title: Fuel Leak?
author: A70bier
issue_summary: Owner of 1987 Supra experiencing fuel leak smell towards the front of the engine, initially uncertain of the source with a disconnected line visible.
symptoms: suspected fuel leak towards front of engine
fix_summary: Fuel leak identified at the fuel injectors using dye. Owner planning to reseal or replace injector o-rings and gaskets.
key_takeaway: Fuel leaks on MK3 Supras can be diagnosed using dye in the fuel tank or by jumping Fp and +B in the diagnostic block to pressurize the fuel system without starting the engine, and injector o-rings/gaskets are common leak points that should be lubricated with motor oil during installation.
